caption: Seen from under the water, the wavering shapes of the trees and the pool ladder show through the surface.

sa.check: The view is from under the water.
The wavering shapes of trees and a pool ladder show through the surface.
The shapes steady when the water is calm.

pc.expect: The shapes are visible through the surface and their outlines ripple with it.
pc.fail: The surface is opaque; or the shapes are rigid on a plainly rippled surface; or they ripple on a flat calm.

pc.expect: The trees and ladder themselves do not move; only their image wavers.
pc.fail: The ladder bends; or the trees sway with no wind; or a different scene appears.

pc.expect: The surface is liquid: ripples pass and fade.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or ripples freeze; or the water leaps.

pc.expect: The surface moves only with a visible cause.
pc.fail: It churns with nothing disturbing it; or the view jumps; or the ladder moves.
The ladder vanishes; or a second appears; or the water becomes solid.

pc.expect: The pool and the trees stay the same.
pc.fail: The pool walls change; or the trees change colour; or the sky changes.
